records.text: An inside source told Candace Owens that Erika Kirk may have been named in Charlie Kirk’s will and may have inherited approximately 10 million dollars.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 1QZ4X6q1DPg)

appearances.snippet: I'm told Erika (Erika Kirk) actually was named and she inherited 10 million. That may or may not be correct.

verification.notes: Transcript context makes clear this was an unnamed inside source and Candace herself caveated that the amount may or may not be correct. Current reporting discusses estate planning, family assets, and possible insurance but no public will, probate filing, or reliable document establishes that Erika was named in a will and inherited approximately 10 million. The attributed private-source claim cannot be independently verified.

sources.title: Hunter Biden Returns. The White House Ghosts Me Regarding Erika - Candace Ep 340
sources.relevance: Primary source for the anonymous claim and Candace explicit uncertainty.

sources.title: Fact Check: No evidence Charlie Kirk wrote Erika Kirk out of his will
sources.relevance: Documents the lack of a verified public will record amid competing estate rumors.
